about: 50 publicly known video editing styles, written up from public craft knowledge (film-editing guides, video essays, creator style breakdowns). Pace numbers are ESTIMATED starting targets, not measured from a reference; replace them by running `analyze-style` on a reference the owner shares. `known_from` names public examples for study only; never copy their footage, music or graphics.

styles.name: Bold word-by-word captions
styles.best_for: talking-head advice, business, motivation, one strong speaker
styles.hook: The boldest claim as the first spoken words, on a tight punch-in, caption already on screen.
styles.structure: Claim, proof or story, one-line takeaway; no intro, no outro.
styles.cutting: Jump cuts remove every breath and pause over 0.25 s; punch-in alternates every 2 cuts.
styles.camera: Single locked medium shot; digital punch-ins 110-125 % fake a second angle.
styles.type: 1-3 words per caption, heavy sans (800-900 weight), uppercase, white with the key word in yellow or green, centre frame, pop-in scale 90-105 %.
styles.mg: Occasional icon or emoji pop beside the key word; progress bar optional.
styles.colour: Clean, contrasty, slightly saturated skin; dark background helps captions read.
styles.sound: Voice-forward, light bass bed at -22 dB, whoosh or click on punch-ins.
twists: Captions change colour with the speaker's emotion
Key numbers counted up as motion graphics

styles.name: Retention maximalist
styles.hook: Show the end state or the stakes in the first second, then promise the payoff.
styles.structure: Stakes, escalation every 20-40 s, countdown or scoreboard, payoff, quick exit.
styles.cutting: Something changes on screen every 1-2 s: angle, zoom, text, graphic or SFX.
styles.camera: Many angles, wide lenses, reaction close-ups.
styles.transitions: Hard cuts, whip pans, zoom transitions on scene changes.
styles.type: Big outlined numbers and stakes text; money and time counters.
styles.mg: Counters, timers, arrows, circle highlights, map pins.
styles.sound: Constant music bed with risers, hits on reveals, cartoon SFX, music drops out for key lines.
styles.vfx: Zoom punches, screen shake on impacts, freeze-frame reactions.
avoid: any shot over 4 s without change
twists: Countdown timer that becomes the transition
Reveal shown first, then rewound

styles.name: Podcast clip
styles.hook: Start mid-sentence on the most surprising line; context comes after.
styles.structure: Hot line, context, the turn, the punchline; ends on a reaction or open question.
styles.cutting: Cut to whoever is speaking; L-cuts let a reaction land under the other voice.
styles.camera: Stacked or alternating single shots reframed to 9:16; wide shot for laughs.
styles.mg: Name and title lower third once; occasional B-roll still with a slow push.
styles.colour: Warm studio look, matched between cameras.
styles.sound: Voice only or a very low bed; room tone kept; no SFX on serious lines.
twists: Split screen at the disagreement
Freeze on the reaction with a one-word caption

styles.name: Clean productivity explainer
styles.hook: A relatable problem stated in one line, with the answer teased.
styles.structure: Problem, numbered ideas with examples, recap.
styles.cutting: Unhurried; B-roll of hands, desk, apps under voice.
styles.camera: Soft-lit medium shot, shallow depth of field, clean set.
styles.type: Handwritten-style or rounded sans captions; idea number cards.
styles.mg: Screen recordings in rounded frames, highlight underline animations.
styles.colour: Muted, grey-scale backgrounds with one accent colour that pops.
styles.sound: Lo-fi or acoustic bed, soft clicks on graphics.
styles.vfx: Selective colour pop on the key object.
twists: The accent colour tracks the idea count

styles.name: Daily vlog with hyperlapses
styles.hook: Direct address with the day's mission, then a fast hyperlapse.
styles.structure: Mission, journey montages, obstacle, resolution, sign-off.
styles.cutting: Talking pieces cut tight, music montages between them.
styles.camera: Handheld selfie, tripod-on-the-ground shots, drones, time-lapse.
styles.transitions: Hard cuts on beat; speed ramps into hyperlapses.
styles.sound: Music-driven montages; natural sound kept in talk sections.
twists: The whole day told as one continuous hyperlapse with voice-over

styles.name: POV storytime
styles.hook: "POV:" text over the first frame sets the situation instantly.
styles.structure: Set-up text, escalation, twist, loopable last beat.
styles.cutting: Cut on reactions; tension held with one longer shot before the twist.
styles.camera: First-person or close single, handheld.
styles.transitions: Hard cuts, smash cut to the twist.
styles.sound: Trending-sound energy (use original or licensed audio), silence before the twist.
styles.vfx: None, or a zoom on the twist.
avoid: polished graphics that break the native feel
twists: The last frame matches the first so it loops

styles.name: Screen tutorial
styles.hook: Show the finished result first, then how.
styles.structure: Result, numbered steps, recap.
styles.cutting: Cut out loading and typing; speed up repetitive actions.
styles.camera: Screen capture with face cam in a corner.
styles.mg: Zoom into the cursor area, highlight boxes, click ripples.
styles.sound: Clear voice, soft click SFX.
twists: Speed-run version at the end in 10 seconds

styles.name: UGC product ad
styles.hook: Pain point or bold result in the first second, product visible by second 3.
styles.structure: Hook, problem, product demo, proof, offer and call to action.
styles.cutting: Fast talking-head jump cuts intercut with product close-ups.
styles.camera: Handheld selfie, macro product shots.
styles.mg: Price tag, star rating, before/after labels, CTA button.
styles.sound: Upbeat bed, pop SFX on callouts.
twists: The product solves the problem in a single match cut

styles.name: Before/after transformation
styles.best_for: makeovers, renovation, fitness, cleaning, art process
styles.hook: The 'before' with a promise, or a flash of the 'after'.
styles.structure: Before, fast process montage, held beat, reveal on the drop.
styles.cutting: Accelerating process cuts, silence or riser, reveal exactly on the beat drop.
styles.camera: Locked angle so before and after match.
styles.transitions: Match cut or flash at the reveal.
styles.colour: Before slightly flat, after graded richer.
styles.sound: Build-up track, drop at reveal, whoosh into it.
styles.vfx: White flash on reveal, speed ramp.
avoid: changing the angle between before and after
twists: Wipe that reveals the after inside the before frame

styles.name: Countdown listicle
styles.hook: Tease number one before starting at five.
styles.structure: Tease, 5 to 1 with a card each, number one held longest.
styles.cutting: Each item: card, two or three supporting shots, verdict.
styles.camera: Mixed B-roll and talking.
styles.colour: Consistent brand palette per item card.
styles.sound: Sting on each number, music lifts toward number one.
twists: The ranking reverses at the end

styles.name: Meme chaos edit
styles.hook: Absurd image or sound in the first half-second.
styles.structure: Set-up, escalating absurdity, freeze-frame punchline.
styles.cutting: Snap zooms, freeze frames, deliberate bad cuts for comedy.
styles.camera: Anything; crash zooms on faces.
styles.type: Impact-style meme text, captions with emoji.
styles.sound: Boom, record-scratch, bass-boosted hits, sudden silence.
styles.vfx: Crash zoom, shake, freeze frame, RGB split.
twists: A serious documentary narrator over the chaos

styles.name: Soft aesthetic vlog
styles.hook: A beautiful detail shot (light, steam, hands) with ambient sound.
styles.structure: Morning-to-night or process order, gentle text notes.
styles.cutting: Cut on small actions, ASMR moments held.
styles.camera: Tripod and gentle handheld, close details, natural light.
styles.type: Small lowercase serif or handwritten notes.
styles.sound: Lo-fi or acoustic bed, foley up front (pouring, pages).
twists: Entire video in one colour family, changing with the time of day

styles.name: Green-screen commentary
styles.hook: The headline or screenshot itself, with the creator pointing at it.
styles.structure: Headline, what it means, what nobody says, opinion.
styles.cutting: Background swaps on each new source; jump cuts on the speaker.
styles.camera: Creator keyed over the evidence, lower half of frame.
styles.sound: Voice only or low bed.
twists: The speaker steps 'into' the screenshot with a zoom

styles.name: News explainer short
styles.best_for: current affairs, Hindi explainers, 'what happened' stories
styles.hook: The surprising fact as text plus voice in the first second.
styles.structure: Fact, background in three beats, why it matters, open question.
styles.cutting: Archival and stock images change on every sentence.
styles.camera: Stills with push-ins, maps, presenter optional.
styles.type: Bold Hindi/English headline text top, captions centre.
styles.mg: Map pins, date stamps, source credits.
styles.colour: Contrasty with a brand accent (red or yellow).
styles.sound: Tense pulse bed, whoosh on headline changes.
twists: Timeline scrubber at the bottom showing where in history each beat sits

styles.name: Kinetic comedy montage
known_from: Edgar Wright films (Hot Fuzz, Shaun of the Dead)
styles.best_for: comedy, everyday routines made epic, prep sequences
styles.hook: A mundane action shot like an action-film close-up.
styles.structure: Rapid 'tool-up' montages bracketed by deadpan holds.
styles.cutting: Ultra-short close-ups cut exactly on SFX; whip pans as transitions; the joke lands on a held wide.
styles.camera: Extreme close-ups of objects, whip pans, crash zooms.
styles.transitions: Whip pans and match cuts between scenes.
styles.sound: Every cut has a designed sound (door, click, swish); music synced to action.
twists: The montage plays backwards for the undo joke

styles.name: Symmetry storybook
styles.best_for: whimsical stories, character introductions, travel postcards
styles.hook: A perfectly centred tableau with a title card.
styles.structure: Chapters with title cards, deadpan narration.
styles.cutting: Metric cuts on the music meter; symmetrical shot-reverse-shot; whip pans between centred frames.
styles.camera: Centred, flat, one-point compositions; lateral dollies; overhead inserts.
styles.type: Centred serif or Futura-style title cards.
styles.colour: Pastel palette, often two dominant colours.
styles.sound: Baroque or folk score, deadpan voice-over.
twists: Indian miniature-painting palette in a symmetry frame

styles.name: Crime caper snap
styles.hook: Freeze frame on a character with a name title.
styles.structure: Parallel threads cross-cut until they collide.
styles.cutting: Clip editing: speed ramps, freeze frames, rewinds, parallel editing.
styles.camera: Low angles, snap zooms, split screens.
styles.sound: Eclectic soundtrack, record-scratch rewinds, punchy hits.
twists: Rewind effect to show the same moment from another character

styles.name: Chapter title cards
styles.hook: A tense cold open dialogue, then the title.
styles.structure: Named chapters, out of order; long dialogue scenes then sudden violence of pace.
styles.cutting: Long held dialogue, then crash zooms and snap cuts at the turn.
styles.camera: Trunk shots, crash zooms, low angles.
styles.sound: Needle-drop era songs, silence in tension.
twists: Chapter numbers counting down instead of up

styles.name: Parallel cross-cut build
styles.hook: A ticking deadline stated or shown.
styles.structure: Two or three timelines cross-cut, shots shortening as they converge.
styles.cutting: Cross-cutting with accelerating rhythm; sound bridges link timelines.
styles.camera: Wide anamorphic frames, practical locations.
styles.sound: Ticking pulse, rising tone, heavy low end.
avoid: losing the viewer in which timeline is which
twists: Each timeline has its own grade so the cross-cuts read instantly

styles.name: Noir voice-over
styles.hook: A first-person line of fatalistic voice-over over a shadowy image.
styles.structure: Flashback framed by narration.
styles.cutting: Slow, deliberate; dissolves for time jumps.
styles.camera: Low key, venetian-blind shadows, Dutch angles.
styles.sound: Muted trumpet or piano, rain, city ambience.
twists: Only one object stays in colour (selective colour)

styles.name: Bollywood masala hero entry
styles.best_for: hero or product entries, celebrations, dramatic moments
styles.hook: Feet, hands or silhouette first; the face held back.
styles.structure: Build-up details, slow-motion reveal, punch dialogue, celebration.
styles.cutting: Detail inserts accelerating to a slow-motion hero shot; cut on BGM hits.
styles.camera: Low angles, slow-motion, wind and dust, rotating dolly.
styles.transitions: Whip cuts, white flashes on hits.
styles.type: Big stylised title in Hindi and English.
styles.colour: Warm golden or teal-orange, rich contrast.
styles.sound: Heavy BGM with dhol or brass hits, whooshes, silence before the punch line.
styles.vfx: Speed ramps, flash frames, shake on hits.
twists: The hero entry used for an everyday object, played straight

styles.name: South Indian mass elevation
known_from: Telugu, Tamil and Kannada mass films
styles.best_for: power moments, fan edits, sports heroes
styles.hook: Silence, then a single impact sound and a low-angle shot.
styles.structure: Threat, hero arrives, elevation shots, impact, title.
styles.cutting: Ramp-in to slow-motion, cuts on every BGM accent, repeated hero angle twice.
styles.camera: Extreme low angles, rotating shots, dust and sparks.
styles.colour: High contrast, orange-teal or monochrome with red accents.
styles.sound: Thunderous percussion, choir chants, sub-bass hits, sudden silence.
twists: Mass treatment for a grandmother making chai

styles.name: Step-printed romance
styles.hook: Smeared neon motion with an intimate voice-over line.
styles.structure: Fragments of memory, repeated motifs, voice-over diary.
styles.cutting: Elliptical; repeated slow-motion motifs; time stamps.
styles.camera: Handheld, through glass and doorways, step-printed motion.
styles.type: Clock times and dates as text.
styles.colour: Saturated neon greens and reds, deep shadows.
styles.sound: A recurring waltz-like theme, rain, city hum.
styles.vfx: Step-print smear (frame blending at low frame rates), slow motion.
twists: Mumbai local train at night as the neon city

styles.name: Poetic nature elegy
styles.best_for: memories, nature, spiritual or philosophical pieces
styles.hook: Golden light through grass with a whispered question.
styles.structure: Associative, not linear; whispered voice-over questions.
styles.cutting: Elliptical cuts mid-action; never lingers on dialogue.
styles.camera: Moving handheld or Steadicam, magic hour, wide lenses, sky.
styles.sound: Classical and choral, wind, whispered voice.
twists: Indian village dawn edited as a prayer

styles.name: One-point dread
styles.hook: A long one-point corridor with a slow push in.
styles.structure: Long held scenes, classical score against violence or calm.
styles.cutting: Few cuts; slow zooms do the work.
styles.camera: One-point perspective, slow zooms, symmetrical corridors.
styles.sound: Classical pieces, droning tones.
twists: A Kubrick stare cut into a cooking video

styles.name: Movie trailer cut
styles.hook: A quiet line of dialogue in black, then a big image.
styles.structure: Three acts: set-up, the rise with title cards, rapid montage, silence, button joke or line, title.
styles.cutting: Slow first act, accelerating montage cut to the drum, hard stop to black before the button.
styles.camera: Best-of shots only.
styles.transitions: Cuts to black, flashes on hits.
styles.type: Big serif or condensed title cards between shots.
styles.sound: Braams, risers, a slowed cover song, dramatic silence.
twists: A trailer for an ordinary day

styles.name: Horror dread and jump
known_from: modern horror films and creepy Shorts
styles.hook: Something slightly wrong in a calm frame.
styles.structure: Normal, wrongness grows, long hold, scare, aftermath.
styles.cutting: Uncomfortably long holds, then a jump cut on the scare.
styles.camera: Negative space, slow push, doorways.
styles.sound: Low drones, silence before the scare, sharp stinger.
twists: No scare at all: the tension never releases

styles.name: Annotated explainer
styles.hook: A surprising chart or archival image with the question.
styles.structure: Question, layers of evidence, the answer, what it means.
styles.cutting: Archival footage and documents animated in parallax.
styles.camera: Archival, documents, interviews.
styles.type: Clean sans, highlighter annotations on documents.
styles.mg: Paper texture, highlighter swipes, charts, maps.
styles.colour: Desaturated archival with brand accent colour.
styles.sound: Ambient electronic bed, paper SFX.
twists: The annotations are hand-drawn in Devanagari

styles.name: Map and desk explainer
styles.hook: A map zoom from space to a single place with a question.
styles.structure: Question, investigation on the desk and on location, answer.
styles.cutting: Presenter, map zooms and paper-on-desk inserts intercut.
styles.camera: Overhead desk shots with hands, handheld on location.
styles.sound: Textured ambient score, paper and pen foley.
twists: The map is a hand-painted Indian scroll

styles.name: Archival documentary (Ken Burns effect)
styles.hook: A face from an old photograph with a quote read aloud.
styles.structure: Chronological chapters, letters read by voices, interviews.
styles.cutting: Slow pans and zooms on stills; long dissolves.
styles.camera: Rostrum moves on photographs.
styles.type: Classic serif lower thirds and dates.
styles.sound: Period music, quiet ambience, read quotes.
twists: Pan reveals a detail that changes the story

styles.name: True-crime series
styles.hook: The most chilling interview line over an evidence image.
styles.structure: Cold open, timeline, interviews, reveal, cliffhanger.
styles.cutting: Interviews intercut with slow evidence shots and reenactments.
styles.camera: Off-centre interview framing, slow sliders on evidence.
styles.transitions: Cuts, dip to black at reveals.
styles.sound: Ticking pulses, low drones, silence before revelations.
twists: The case board builds itself across the episode

styles.name: Interview and B-roll documentary
styles.hook: An emotional line from the subject over an evocative B-roll shot.
styles.structure: Who, struggle, turning point, now.
styles.cutting: A-roll interview with B-roll covering every edit point; J- and L-cuts.
styles.camera: Two-camera interview, cinematic B-roll.
styles.sound: Piano or ambient score rising at the turning point.
twists: The subject's own home videos as B-roll

styles.name: Data story
styles.hook: One shocking number counting up.
styles.structure: Number, context, comparison, what changes.
styles.cutting: Chart builds paced to the voice; cutaways to real footage.
styles.camera: Graphics-led.
styles.mg: Animated bar, line and map charts, counters.
styles.sound: Light electronic bed, tick SFX on counters.
twists: The chart bars are real objects (stacked rotis, coins)

styles.name: History short
styles.best_for: history, mythology, forgotten stories in Hindi
styles.hook: "Ye kahani kisi ne nahi batayi..." over a striking painting or still.
styles.structure: Mystery, the story in three beats, twist, loop line.
styles.cutting: Stills and paintings with push-ins, cut on every sentence.
styles.camera: Rostrum moves on paintings, maps.
styles.sound: Indian classical instruments, deep narration, drum hits on reveals.
twists: The painting comes alive with subtle parallax

styles.name: Video essay
known_from: Every Frame a Painting video essays
styles.hook: A clip that perfectly shows the thesis.
styles.structure: Thesis, examples, counter-example, conclusion.
styles.cutting: Clips cut to the narration's argument, side-by-side comparisons.
styles.camera: Clips and stills.
styles.type: Clean sans labels with film titles and years.
styles.sound: Narration, source audio for examples, minimal music.
twists: The essay is edited in the style it analyses

styles.name: Beat-sync montage
styles.hook: The best shot on the first beat.
styles.structure: Intro bars slow, verse medium, chorus fast, outro slow.
styles.cutting: Every cut on a beat; double-time on the chorus; motion matched across cuts.
styles.camera: Anything with movement.
styles.transitions: Cuts on beat, flash on downbeats.
styles.sound: One track carries everything; natural sound only for accents.
twists: Cuts on the lyric words instead of the beat

styles.name: Seamless travel transitions
styles.hook: A whip or spin transition into a breathtaking wide.
styles.structure: Journey montage, peak moment, calm ending.
styles.cutting: Motion-matched transitions (whip, spin, zoom, mask through objects); speed ramps.
styles.camera: Gimbal moves, drones, whip pans planned for transitions.
styles.sound: Energetic track, whooshes on every transition, ambience layers.
twists: Every transition passes through a door or window of Indian architecture

styles.name: Moody cinematic B-roll
styles.hook: A macro detail with sound (pour, click, steam).
styles.structure: Detail build-up, the reveal shot, end card.
styles.cutting: Cuts on foley sounds; parallax slider shots.
styles.camera: Macro, slider, shallow depth, practical lights.
styles.sound: Foley-forward, punchy beat.
twists: One shot is a deliberate fake-out reveal

styles.name: Music video performance
styles.hook: The artist's face on the first lyric.
styles.structure: Performance intercut with narrative, lip-sync locked.
styles.cutting: Cuts on bars and lyric phrases; multi-angle performance.
styles.camera: Multi-cam performance, stylised lighting.
styles.sound: The song only.
styles.vfx: Flashes, strobe, speed changes (shoot fast, play slow).
twists: One continuous take for the bridge

styles.name: Cinematic wedding film
styles.hook: A vow or letter line over a slow-motion detail.
styles.structure: Preparation, emotion, ceremony, celebration, vows to end.
styles.cutting: Slow motion for emotion, real time for dance; vows as voice-over.
styles.camera: Gimbal, long lens candids, drone.
styles.sound: Emotional score, vows and speeches as voice-over, dhol for celebration.
twists: Edited as a film trailer with title cards

styles.name: Sports hype
styles.hook: The biggest impact moment, frozen.
styles.structure: Build, hits, the winning moment, title.
styles.cutting: Speed ramps around impacts, cuts on bass hits.
styles.camera: Telephoto, slow motion, crowd.
styles.sound: Hard trap or orchestral hybrid, crowd roars, impact hits.
styles.vfx: Shake, flash, speed ramp, motion blur.
twists: Gully cricket shot like a world-cup final

styles.name: Fashion strobe edit
styles.hook: A flash-frame burst of looks.
styles.structure: Look after look on the beat, final hero pose freeze.
styles.cutting: Strobe cuts, repeated frames, freezes on poses.
styles.camera: Flash photography feel, studio backdrops.
styles.sound: House or techno, shutter SFX.
styles.vfx: Strobe flashes, freeze frames, RGB split.
twists: Every look appears on a different Indian textile backdrop

styles.name: Velocity edit
styles.hook: A speed-ramped shot snapping to slow motion on the drop.
styles.structure: Fast-slow-fast ramps on every phrase.
styles.cutting: Speed curves within each clip: fast in, slow on the beat, fast out.
styles.camera: Any clip with clear motion.
styles.sound: Phonk or remix with heavy bass.
twists: Velocity edit of a classical dancer's mudras

styles.name: Glitch and datamosh
styles.hook: A clean image that glitches apart.
styles.structure: Order breaking into chaos and back.
styles.cutting: Glitch hits on beats, stutter repeats.
styles.camera: Any.
styles.sound: Bit-crushed glitch SFX, electronic music.
twists: Glitches reveal a hidden second image underneath

styles.name: Retro VHS camcorder
styles.hook: A camcorder REC and date stamp.
styles.structure: Home-movie fragments, memory voice-over.
styles.cutting: Rough in-camera style cuts, tape glitches between scenes.
styles.camera: Handheld, zoom rocker moves.
styles.type: VCR mono font, date stamp bottom right.
styles.sound: Tape hiss, wow and flutter, home-video audio.
twists: A modern event filmed like 1996

styles.name: Collage mixed media
styles.hook: A cut-out figure pasted onto an unexpected background.
styles.structure: Layers added and torn away.
styles.cutting: Stop-motion stutter at 8-12 fps on graphics.
styles.camera: Stills and cut-outs.
styles.sound: Paper rustles, scissors, playful score.
twists: Collage from old Indian matchbox and poster art

styles.name: Kinetic typography
styles.hook: The first word slams in on the first beat.
styles.structure: Text is the picture; every phrase has its own motion.
styles.cutting: Text changes on syllables and beats.
styles.camera: Type on colour fields, occasional footage behind.
styles.type: Two typefaces maximum, size contrast for emphasis.
styles.mg: Built in Hyperframes: scale, slide, mask reveals synced to voice.
styles.sound: Voice or song drives the timing; soft whooshes.
twists: Devanagari letters assemble from their strokes

styles.name: One-take with hidden cuts
known_from: oner sequences in films and music videos
styles.hook: The camera starts moving with intent in the first frame.
styles.structure: One journey with reveals along the way.
styles.cutting: Cuts hidden in whip pans, dark frames or objects passing the lens.
styles.camera: Gimbal or Steadicam, choreographed.
styles.sound: Continuous ambience and music; no audio jumps.
twists: A one-take walk through a crowded Indian market

styles.name: Dreamlike surreal
known_from: surreal music videos and AI-video art
styles.best_for: dreams, memories, AI-generated footage, art pieces
styles.hook: An impossible image held just long enough to register.
styles.structure: Dream logic: images morph into each other.
styles.cutting: Long dissolves and morphs, reverse motion, slow motion.
styles.camera: Floating moves, unusual perspectives.
styles.colour: Pastel or saturated dream palette, glow.
styles.sound: Reverb-heavy pads, reversed sounds, distant voices.
styles.vfx: Glow, reverse, slow motion, double exposure.

styles.name: AI cinematic short
known_from: AI-generated short films on social platforms
styles.best_for: AI-generated clips, concept trailers, story shorts
styles.hook: The most impossible generated shot first, with a voice line.
styles.structure: Trailer-like three beats; each generated clip used for its best 1-3 s only.
styles.cutting: Cut before AI artefacts appear; hide morphing with cuts on motion; consistent character shots grouped.
styles.camera: Generated camera moves; prefer clips with one clear move.
styles.transitions: Cuts, flash frames, dips to black between beats.
styles.colour: One unified grade to glue different generations together.
styles.sound: Designed soundscape carries continuity across mismatched clips: ambience, risers, hits, voice-over.
styles.vfx: Grain and letterbox unify; slow motion hides jitter.
avoid: mixing clips with different looks ungraded
twists: The AI artefacts are used on purpose as a 'memory decaying' effect
